§6Retrievers§f

§aPull items and fluids from anywhere in the network to a single point, the opposite of a servo!§f

§bRetrievers§f search the entire duct network and pull matching contents into the block they're attached to. Servos extract from the adjacent block, retrievers grab from everywhere.

§6Tiers§f:
§b• Basic§f: §e3s§f delay, §e8× stack§f, §e50%§f fluid, §e3 slots§f.
§b• Hardened§f: §e2s§f, §e16× stack§f, §e75%§f, §e6 slots§f.
§b• Reinforced§f: §e1s§f, §e32× stack§f, §e100%§f, §e9 slots§f. Max stock: §e64§f.
§b• Signalum§f: §e0.5s§f, §e64× stack§f, §e2× speed§f, §e150%§f, §e12 slots§f. Max stock: §e128§f.
§b• Resonant§f: §e0.5s§f, §e64× stack§f, §e3× speed§f, §e200%§f, §e15 slots§f. Max stock: §e320§f.

Routing modes (Reinforced+): Nearest, Furthest, Random, Round Robin.

§eTip§f: Drop a Retriever on a chest to pull specific items from across your entire itemduct network.
